editorialSummary.heading: Comal ISD's 2026-2027 breaks, conferences and weather dates
highlights: Fair Day September 25; no weeklong October fall break
October 21-22 conferences shorten elementary days only
January 5 winter return; March 8-12 Spring Break
March 29 and April 23 possible weather make-up dates
paragraphs: Comal ISD students begin Tuesday, August 25, 2026, and finish Thursday, May 27, 2027. Fair Day is Friday, September 25. There is no weeklong October fall break; October 12 is a single student holiday for staff development. Thanksgiving break runs November 23-27, and Holiday Break runs December 21-January 1. With staff development on January 4, students return January 5.

Elementary parent-teacher conferences are October 21 and 22, with two-hour early release for elementary students only. Middle and high school students are not included in that conference early-release schedule. All students have two-hour early release on December 18 and again on May 27, the last day of school.

Spring Break runs March 8-12, with students returning March 15. Good Friday is a student/staff holiday on March 26. March 29 and April 23 are reserved bad-weather make-up days, so either date may become a school day if needed.

Calculated dismissal times subtract two hours from printed regular hours and should be checked against campus instructions. Activated weather make-up dates can change the student-day total. Grading-period boundaries do not imply report-card distribution. Appointments, testing, ceremonies and any emergency changes require separate campus or district information.
